blocks.label: relationships
blocks.extractionHint: Record the interactions, promises and memorable details that actually happened between each character and the player. Numeric affinity belongs to the Affinity panel; stage, trust and pressure for the five route characters belong to Heart Routes; supporting characters’ trust, pressure and non-romantic relationship state, and all eight characters’ Public Closeness, belong to their character profiles. Do not keep a second current copy of these numbers or stages here.

blocks.label: campus_schedule
blocks.extractionHint: The current location and weather, the next bell or plan for closing time, which characters could naturally turn up, and where anyone has arranged to go. The world-time plugin owns the current date and time of day; do not keep a second clock in memory.
